feed.caption:
Today’s Gospel (Tuesday, November 17, New Calendar): Luke 14:25–35, on counting the cost of following Christ.

“Whoever doesn’t bear his own cross and come after me, can’t be my disciple.”

The Lord speaks of the man who builds a tower and the king who goes out to war: each first sits down to count the cost. He ends with salt that becomes flat and tasteless: “He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”
